q: The drug used for apnoea of prematurity is:
e: Caffeine (or aminophylline) stimulates the respiratory centre.

q: A 30-week baby on feeds develops distension and bloody stool; X-ray shows gas in the bowel wall. Diagnosis:
Kangaroo mother care is suitable for:
e: Stable LBW babies benefit from continuous skin-to-skin care.
